submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires on a restrictive limiter that introduces a small quantity or a narrowed scope -- above all ' only' (also weaker ' just', ' about', ' nearly', ' even', sentence-initial ' Only') -- and peaks on the ' a' right after it in 'only a / just a (few, handful, total)', strongest in scarcity frames like 'There are only', 'had only', 'of those, only'; a separate weaker job fires on a short consonant+'a' fragment token inside a split code or foreign word (sh|a|256, SL|A|VE, #da4939, AZER|BA|YCAN, line-initial 'La'). Ordinary prose with no limiter word and no such fragment stays near 0 on every token (no position or first-token floor); verb-modifying 'only' in short generic sentences ('I only want') is weak (~0.2).
